config.selection_rule: Maximize source-category mean balanced accuracy at separate source-normal-calibrated image cutoffs; tie: mean source AUROC; then smaller lambda. No target inputs or labels.
config.stop_rule: Complete bottle development check and all 12 VisA categories, three support draws, before applying stop to overall VisA category-cluster bootstrap. Stop without tuning if paired interval includes zero or balanced-accuracy gain disappears under per-method calibration.
config.stop_rule_primary: mean per-category image AUROC hybrid-minus-baseline across support draws; calibrated balanced accuracy must also improve

figure_rule.true_negative: lowest hybrid score among native normals below/equal locked image cutoff
figure_rule.false_positive: highest hybrid score among native normals above locked image cutoff
figure_rule.miss: lowest hybrid score among native anomalies below/equal locked image cutoff
figure_rule.smallest_defect: fewest positive full-frame 448x448 GT pixels among native anomalies
figure_rule.localization_failure: lowest hybrid pixel IoU at calibrated pixel cutoff among native anomalies
figure_rule.ties: native image ID; deduplicate and keep all reasons; report absent events

config.geometry_scope: Entire input field resized to448x448 without cropping; GT full-image resized nearest to448x448; maps evaluated/saved at identical448x448 shape. Native-resolution metrics are not claimed.
config.history: Bottle is development evidence. VisA has prior prototype exposure; this is a controlled known-dataset comparison, not untouched-data generalization. Earlier numerical core unchanged.
deviations: Internal baseline and adapted implementation; no claim of official VisionAD reproduction.
Only global PCA95%, uniform additive gate; lambda selected on AD2 only.
Image and pixel cutoffs separately fit for each candidate from AD2 train normals; no extra target calibration images.
AD2 public-test anomalies used only for source lambda selection, not cutoff calibration.
One-shot only, three support draws, nested support prefixes; no full paper shot sweep.
Frozen official DINOv2 ViT-L/14 register weights, mean zero-based blocks4–18, three slots and six support views as existing internal recipe.
AU-PRO is sampled at128 raw-score rank thresholds; query-image bootstrap holds each original grid fixed.
